Safety and Security Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift.  With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane.  Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.Technology and Telematics Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. description: This 2018 Honda Accord Sport delivers reliable performance and practical features that make it an excellent choice for everyday driving and commuting.  - 1.5T turbocharged four-cylinder engine with CVT transmission - 29 city MPG and 35 highway MPG for solid fuel efficiency - Front-wheel drive with four-wheel independent suspension - 19-inch machine-finished alloy wheels with black inserts - Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration - Dual front zone automatic climate control with rear window defroster - Leather steering wheel and leather shift knob - Power driver seat with telescoping and tilt steering wheel - Fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature and front fog lights - Exterior parking camera with rear view capability - Comprehensive airbag system including dual front, side, and overhead airbags - Electronic Stability Control and traction control - Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS - Remote keyless entry and HondaLink emergency communication system  The Accord Sport provides a well-rounded driving experience with its turbocharged engine delivering responsive acceleration while maintaining excellent fuel economy. The independent suspension works to absorb road imperfections, creating a composed ride whether you're navigating city streets or cruising highways. The Silver exterior finish presents a clean, professional appearance that complements the vehicle's modern styling.  Inside, you'll find thoughtful appointments designed for daily comfort and convenience. The automatic dual-zone climate control ensures both driver and passenger can adjust their preferred temperatures independently. Power windows, door locks, and the adjustable power driver seat adapt to your specific preferences, while the leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob add a touch of refinement to the cabin.  Safety is integrated throughout this Accord with multiple airbag placement, electronic stability control, and four-wheel independent braking. The exterior parking camera assists when reversing, and the electronic brake assist provides additional confidence in emergency situations. The HondaLink emergency communication system connects you to roadside assistance when needed.  Technology integration is straightforward with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility on the audio system, allowing seamless smartphone connectivity. Steering wheel-mounted controls give you command of audio and phone functions without taking your hands off the wheel. The 180-watt audio system with eight speakers provides clear sound quality for your daily commute. Speed sensing steering and four-wheel independent suspension tune handling characteristics for both highway confidence and street-level control, while electronic stability control works with traction systems for predictable behavior across conditions.  The 6-speed automatic transmission with Select-Shift allows manual gear selection when preferred, while the three-point-two-two rear axle ratio supports the vehicle's dual-purpose character. City fuel economy reaches 16 MPG while highway driving delivers 22 MPG, balancing the V6's capability with practical range. The 20-inch machined aluminum wheels with painted pockets contribute to the Sport's purposeful appearance. description: The 2016 Dodge Charger R/T stands out as a tech-forward sedan with an 8.4-inch Uconnect infotainment system, offering crisp graphics and intuitive touch controls. Integrated Apple CarPlay and Android Auto make smartphone connectivity seamless, so drivers can access navigation, messaging, and music apps hands-free.  Tailored for drivers who demand maximum connectivity on the go, this sedan is ideal for those who integrate technology into daily commutes and weekend adventures alike. Its Uconnect Access service brings emergency communication and remote features, while the clean CARFAX history signals a high-value, trustworthy option. In urban areas like rd St. Homewood, IL, the combination of advanced tech and a proven accident-free record makes it especially appealing for commuters and tech enthusiasts seeking peace of mind while staying digitally connected.  Under the hood, it features a robust HEMI 5.7L V8 Multi Displacement VVT engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission, delivering responsive acceleration and smooth gear changes. Rear-wheel drive ensures engaging handling, while electronic stability control and traction management systems optimize performance in various conditions. The digital throttle and real-time vehicle data displayed through the infotainment system let drivers tailor their experience, blending power with modern technology for a confident, connected drive.  Smart safety is a core strength, with electronic stability control, ABS brakes, and all-speed traction control working together to monitor road conditions and intervene automatically when needed. Sensor-driven features like brake assist and anti-whiplash front head restraints add layers of protection. The Uconnect Access emergency communication system provides rapid response in critical moments, while dual front, side, and overhead airbags offer comprehensive occupant coverage. Rearview and front fog lights enhance visibility, ensuring the sedans technology actively helps prevent accidents and supports driver awareness.  The Plus Group and Quick Order Package 29N R/T equip the Charger with heated front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a premium sound system with six speakers for elevated comfort and entertainment. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Power open and close liftgate - On-demand access. When your arms are full of cargo, the last thing you want to do is set it all down just to open the liftgate, then pick it all back up to load it in. By remotely opening and closing, power liftgate lets you skip straight to the loading. It also eliminates the awkward stretch to reach up for the liftgate to close it. Load and go with power open and close liftgate. Safety and Security Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe. Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal s travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
